svg.title: coderprint: 703k lines of code in use, of 1.4M written, all time
svg.desc: 702,959 lines of code in use (470,845 in production, 232,114 in tests), of 1,413,161 written (all time, charted since 06MAR2026): 3,713 commits across all branches, 67 active days, a longest streak of 40 days, a current streak of 12 days, and 5 languages at 1% or more of the lines of code. They came in 3 bursts of 19k, 56k and 1.3M lines of code. The bars end on 29OCT2026, the day this panel was drawn. Share of lines of code by language: Rust 60%, Lean 19%, Python 12%, TypeScript 5%, JavaScript 3%, other languages under 1%. Of what was written, 50% is kept.
